name: POS Simplify Access Management
description: POS Simplify Access Management is a powerful solution designed to streamline and simplify the process of managing access rights in your Point of Sale system. With intuitive controls, customizable permissions, and secure access management, you can easily assign, monitor, and adjust user roles in real-time. Whether you're a small business or a large enterprise, our app ensures a seamless and secure experience for managing access, improving efficiency, and protecting sensitive data. summary: The POS Access Control app delivers advanced, role-based management for the Odoo Point of Sale system, enabling businesses to precisely define what cashiers, users, or employees can view and perform within the POS interface. Access rules can be configured per POS shop and assigned to specific users or employees, with full support for both single-cashier and multi-employee (POS HR) environments. Built-in validation mechanisms ensure that each user or employee is governed by a single access rule per shop, maintaining consistency and preventing configuration conflicts. The app provides comprehensive control over POS operations by allowing administrators to hide or restrict critical action buttons such as payment, order validation, invoicing, refunds, quotations, pricelists, and order cancellation. Customer-related actions, including customer creation and editing, can also be limited to authorized personnel. These controls help prevent unauthorized activities, reduce cashier errors, and ensure that sensitive operations are performed only by approved users. In addition, the application offers robust product and payment restrictions. Store managers can restrict specific POS product categories so that only relevant products are visible and sellable at the POS. Payment methods can also be limited per cashier or employee, enabling businesses to enforce internal payment policies and minimize checkout mistakes. Restricted categories and payment methods are completely hidden from the POS interface, resulting in a cleaner, more focused selling environment. To further strengthen operational control, the app includes options to disable price, quantity, discount, and numpad actions, restrict cash in/out operations, hide POS session controls, and limit access to debug tools. All access rules are applied automatically and in real time when the POS session starts, without affecting system performance. Overall, the POS Access Control app transforms Odoo POS into a secure, streamlined, and role-aware solution that enhances accuracy, accountability, and day-to-day operational efficiency.
